title: From well-behaved to runaway
engine: research/experiments/REPLICATORS/genome.GenomeLenia (modified rule of ours: per-pixel genome g on the line 213 #84 -> 213 #83; persisting matter keeps g, new matter inherits the 2-px mass-weighted g)
mutation: every 10 tu, g += 0.03 x smoothed (8 px) unit noise, seed 2

frames.mp4: rendered 512 px, re-encoded to 384 px wide, crf 30

view: colour = genome on coolwarm, brightness = 0.1 + 0.9 x field; coral line = this run's mean genome, grey = neutral arm of seed 2 (evolve.jsonl)
caveats: Neutral arm not filmed; its curve is read from evolve.jsonl.
